title: Myanmar Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Myanmar civil war (2021–present)", at revision 1376089047, opens: "The Myanmar civil war began following the military coup on 1 February 2021. The seizure of power triggered mass anti-coup demonstrations and a violent crackdown by the Tatmadaw, which significantly escalated the country's longstanding insurgencies." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q110613097, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "ongoing armed conflict in Myanmar since the 2021 coup d'etat". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
